comparison.objective: Safely reset a breaker by switching its load off first, rather than mechanically tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered switch and breaker actuation; no collar counterholding, hex-key work, or iterative adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Load off, breaker reset, load restored, motor running. Timing and electrical thresholds and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Both include safe de-energized sequencing, but the central tested abilities are different.
